options.label: help

options.label: ver

options.description: active target backend and privilege level
options.label: arch

options.label: uptime

options.label: mem

options.label: caps

options.description: the machine's input session: cursor, focus, counters

options.description: the network device: addresses and driver counters

options.label: tcp

options.label: tls

options.label: nameserver

options.description: navigate the browser to an https:// URL on a trusted host; print the page

options.description: navigate the browser to the previous page
options.label: back

options.description: navigate to link [N] of the current page
options.label: follow

options.description: refuse every navigation to HOST, pinned or not
options.label: block

options.description: drop browser history, page and links; keep trust and blocks
options.label: forget

options.description: the resident risk advisor: what it is, and what it has done since boot
options.label: mlstat

options.description: the resident power governor: every clock domain, its points, heat and holds
options.label: power

options.description: the console's block device geometry
options.label: lsblk

options.description: filesystem space, in blocks
options.label: df

options.description: every named object
options.label: ls

options.description: names beginning with PREFIX
options.label: find

options.description: one object's extent and length
options.label: stat

options.description: an object's contents
options.label: cat

options.description: the first N lines (default 10)
options.label: head

options.description: lines, words and bytes
options.label: wc

options.description: lines of NAME containing TEXT
options.label: grep

options.description: the first N bytes, in hex
options.label: hexdump

options.description: create or atomically replace an object
options.label: write

options.description: add a line to the end of an object
options.label: append

options.label: touch

options.description: copy an object
options.label: cp

options.description: rename an object
options.label: mv
